verdict.rationale: Granola's own docs say it supports multiple languages for both transcription and generated summaries: 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile. Nothing in the pack shows it handling language switching within a meeting, so only the many-languages part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented handling of mid-meeting language switching/code-switching, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English transcription and summary quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching

citations.quote: Granola supports multiple languages for transcription and generated meeting summaries.
Granola supports 31 languages on desktop (macOS and Windows) and 17 languages on mobile (iOS and Android).
